The problem

A model trained on thermal imaging to flag failing components on a PCB before they fail.

Why this project exists

Tomás R. and the team at Technical University of Munich are building this as a ai & data project, currently 63% of the way to a working result.

Objectives

  • → Reach a working prototype in AI & Data
  • → Document the build process as it happens, not after the fact
  • → Publish results the wider ForgeHub community can learn from
